title: The last element, as an option
starter:
let rec last l =
  match l with
  | [] -> None
  | x :: rest -> Some x
hints: The starter returns the first element. When is the first element also the last one?
Add a pattern for a list with exactly one element, `[x]`, before the `x :: rest` case. In the general case, keep looking in `rest`.
`| [x] -> Some x` then `| _ :: rest -> last rest`
explain: There are three shapes: empty (no last element, so `None`), exactly one element `[x]` (that one is the last, `Some x`), and longer lists, where the last element is the last of `rest`. Order matters: `[x]` must come before `_ :: rest`, because `_ :: rest` also matches a one-element list.
